name: Databasement
description: Databasement is a self-hosted backup manager for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite and Redis/Valkey. It runs scheduled or on-demand backups, optionally through an SSH tunnel, stores them locally or on S3, SFTP, FTP, Samba or Azure, and restores them to any registered server.

notes.text: There is no default account: the first account created at /register becomes the administrator and closes sign-up. Anyone who reaches the page can claim it, so create it right after the install.
Back up APP_KEY from /opt/databasement_data/.env. It encrypts the stored server passwords and, unless BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY is set, the backups, so neither can be read without it.
Backup jobs run as www-data, so a local volume needs a path www-data can write to, such as /opt/databasement_data/backups.
